admiral-yularen--fleet-coordinator.text: When Played: Choose Grit, Restore 1, Sentinel, or Shielded. While this unit is in play, each friendly Vehicle unit gains the chosen keyword.
admiral-yularen--fleet-coordinator.rules:
Until Yularen leaves play, each friendly Vehicle unit gains the chosen keyword. This effect is not changed if an opponent takes control of Yularen.
If Yularen is captured and then rescued, his "When Played" effect does not resume.
admiral-yularen--fleet-coordinator.officialRules:
